info.title: nugetscope
info.description: Interactive terminal dashboard for the NuGet packages of a whole .NET solution (.sln/.slnx): outdated, vulnerable, deprecated, mismatched and possibly unused packages, CPM-aware updates, and a headless CI mode with JSON/Markdown reports.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print a JSON report to stdout.

options.name: --markdown
options.description: Print a Markdown report to stdout (e.g. for a CI job summary).

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
Exit with code 2 when a package has one of these statuses:
vulnerable, deprecated, outdated, mismatch (comma-separated) or any.
Prints a text report unless --json or --markdown is given.

options.name: --transitive
options.description: Include transitive packages (slower; checks them too).
